title: Triata Capital Monica Hsiao：市场对明年加息定价过高，最多两到三次
speaker: Monica Shell

segments.en: I do think 100 bips priced in for the for looking hikes cumulatively through next year is definitely overdone in my opinion based on what we know today so you know obviously if you do do one hike the market and I'm sure the Fed as well will not be thinking that 25 bips is going to solve anything in any direction
segments.zh: 我认为，基于我们今天所知，市场对明年累计加息100个基点的定价肯定过头了。所以很明显，如果只加一次息，市场以及美联储肯定都不会认为25个基点能解决任何方向的问题。

segments.en: and you know we are not in in economy where you could say it's overheated there are certain sectoral drivers but it's not it's not overheated so I think for looking I'm I'm seeing you know probably in the in the range of two to three hikes max
segments.zh: 而且我们并没有处于一个可以说经济过热的环境中，有一些行业驱动因素，但并没有过热。所以我认为未来最多也就是两到三次加息。

segments.en: but this this year I would say it's like one or two but you know it's a difficult question on what they will do and what they should do because a lot of people will think well they should have if they wanted to hike they should have done it in in July
segments.zh: 但今年我会说大概一到两次。不过他们将会做什么和应该做什么是个难题，因为很多人会认为，如果他们想加息，早就应该在7月份行动了。

segments.en: now where at a point where you don't have any clear trend in either direction how do you position around that then you mentioned the need for some sort of anchor in the long end right can you still go long in the whole steepener trade
segments.zh: 现在我们处于一个没有任何明确趋势的阶段，你如何围绕这一点进行配置？然后你提到了长端需要某种锚定，对吧？你还能在整体陡峭化交易中做多吗？

segments.en: yeah well so you know we've started to see this flatener yeah I think that this is really a matter of positioning and right now I would say that the positioning is such that we would still be quite careful on duration even though I do think the long end is somewhat anchor you could see 10 year struggles to go past 5 percent
segments.zh: 是的，我们开始看到平坦化。我认为这确实是配置的问题，目前我会说，鉴于当前的配置，我们仍然会对久期相当谨慎，尽管我确实认为长端在某种程度上锚定了，你可以看到10年期收益率难以突破5%。
